name: Tavily
tagline: AI-optimized web search API for research agents
description: Tavily is a search API built for AI agents and RAG pipelines. It returns concise, source-backed web results optimized for LLM consumption, with search, extract, crawl, and map endpoints for research workflows.

auth.details: API key via Authorization Bearer header or api_key body field; self-serve signup

rate_limits: Published by plan on pricing page (e.g. free-tier monthly credit cap and per-minute limits); not "not published"

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.tavily.com/search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' -d '{"query":"latest AI news"}'

use_cases: search the web for current facts for an agent
extract clean page content for RAG
research a topic with source-backed snippets
crawl a site for documentation ingestion
